review_description: First contact was with Jordan.  We supplied some initial information regarding our electricity usage and then he came to our home and clearly explained our options.Within a few days he supplied a quote for solar and battery with three options for us to choose from.We also obtained two other quotes, however neither person, although helpful, visited our home.We had some questions and Jordan provided immediate assistance, including provision of another quote that better suited our needs.Jordan advised us that Audra did all their own work onsite and that he would be there on the day of installation.On the day of installation, Jordan and his partner Matt arrived with another person.  They commenced on time and worked to complete the job without any issues.  From a previous roof inspection, we knew we may have some broken/chipped tiles and they identified those sealed them and advised us, so we could obtain replacements.Upon completing the solar and battery installation, Matt explained how to install the app on our phones so we could have access to the system and the basic operation.They packed up their tools etc and left.  Later that day we had a question about  the operation of the system and Matt returned the next day to check it out.  All was resolved.We would thoroughly recommend Audra Energy.

Great business to deal with. Installation went well and the lads cleaned up and left the place tidy.Matt was the only one to go up onto the roof when quoting .Matt prepared all the paperwork for grid connection, all I had to do was enter my details.The  Sungrow system is generating more power than we need even with the ac running. And the battery powers the house at night with plenty in reserve.Over all very happy I used both Solar Quotes and Audra energy.

Recently had Audra energy install a solar and battery system. Matt was fantastic to deal with throughout the whole process.He promptly come round to provide a quote and spent the time getting to understand our needs and recommend a system that had us covered, even getting up on the roof to make sure what we settled on was going to fit.Install was completed over two days, with no hassles at all. Highly recommend Matt it anyone looking for a stress-free process tha don’t cost an arm and a leg!

We've just had our 32kWh Sig battery installed, along with some additional solar, and very happy with the result. It was all very smooth and everything is working as expected. We highly recommend Matt and his team.

What set Audra apart from the competitors during the sales/quoting process (and the reason I sought them out after a referral from a colleague), is that the owner Matt, physically inspected and measured our roof layout with me. This allowed us to consider the design solution together and discuss its optimisation, which I greatly appreciated.Matt is highly knowledgeable, honest and practical - very happy to answer all of my questions and guide me through the various panel/inverter options, the installation, grid connection and feed-in tariff interactions.We opted for the 8.2kW system (18x 455W Aiko panels) and the 8kW Sungrow 3-phase inverter. Audra's price was the most competitive from the 6-7 quotes we received from the market, offering the best $ per kW - which I attribute to the physical 'measure + quote' approach (more panels installed per m2) and the use of 455W panels.Audra's customer service was everything I had expected, Matt was always punctual as my point of contact and at time of installation, the Audra team were on-time, safe and tidy. Audra even included the shortening of my roof flus to alleviate potential shading on the panels to the quotation and identified a broken tile baton that needed my attention.A month on, I'm extremely happy with the service I received, the slick all-black panels and the system's overall performance - made easy by the live tracking of the home's energy usage.I have no problem recommending Audra (Matt) to others in the Newcastle/Hunter region.

Matt and installation team at Audra were very professional.  Matt came to site to discuss my requirements, which included providing a design that could take a battery in the future.  I felt that Matt asked all the right questions and then made good recommendations on the type of equipment, the location for the inverter and the roof panels.  I decided on a 12.76kW system (29 x 440 watt panels) and 10kW Micro Inverter. At installation time, the Audra team arrived on-time, and were careful, safe and neat.  A month on and I am very happy with the way the system is performing.

Matt and his team are efficient, polite and keen, job was left tidy. Complied with all safety regulations. Neat signage and advisory warnings.  Facilitated the whole process, very easy for me. Great customer service. When meter was upgraded there was a fault, Matt fixed it next day, couldn't be happier with the whole process. Only ones let me choose where i'd like the panels and inverter. Professional install and support afterwards.
When they came to our house they explained everything clearly. They were very pleasant and they didn't try to sell us some thing we didn't want

Over the years I have had a few solar quotes from door to door salesman that were over priced, focused on pushing a particular product, based on desktop assessment and didn't appreciate the complexity of my roof.I found Audra Energy through the Solar Quotes website and decided to contact them based on the strong customer reviews.I received a response to my request for quote quickly. Matt came out to my house and started by getting on the roof to take measurements, looking in my meter box and having a discussion about what I was trying to achieve and my concerns.  He talked me through the pros and cons of different panels and inverters and wasn't trying to push me towards any particular products.Shortly afterwards Matt sent me a quote with 3 options (low cost, mid range cost and higher cost). Each option had detailed cost breakdowns, warranties, expected performance, proposed panel layouts.I had several questions and Matt was quick to respond.After selecting an option and paying the deposit, Matt arranged installation. While there were some delays due to rain and waiting on parts, Matt kept me informed.Installation took 2 whole days due to my roof being complex and needing to have multiple banks of panels spread across 2 levels of roofing. The team worked hard for the 2 days and delivered a really good install.The system is working better than I expected I would in terms of outputs.I am really glad I went with a local (Lake Mac/Newcastle) company that focuses on quality and the customer. The price is also really competitive.Highly recommended!

They were the most professional of the 3 quotes. They visited my home and spent time going through various options and matching a system to my needs. Installation was trouble free and extremely neat. Cleaned up and took away all waste.

We engaged Audra Energy after receiving a number of quotes and visits from other installers. The reason for picking Audra was due to the following;1. Matt came to the house and was the only installer who got on the roof for a measure up, all others only relied on maps views. This was for his peace of mind prior to install. It might seem old school but in a physical world physical practices are still valuable.2. Our discussion during consultation was thorough and he tailored to our needs.3.Audra was very price competitive.4. Installation went smoothly, although we had to upgrade our power from the street, Audra organized a contractor to do this and it went smoothly. The system is producing as per forecast.I would definitely recommend Audra Energy to anyone in the Hunter/Newcastle area.

Thorough quote talking me through the system, the installation and the pros and cons of buying a battery. It was installed yesterday and the team arrived on time, and had the system installed by early afternoon. explained the inverter, the next step and were polite, tidy and thorough. They will send me the paperwork to organise the grid connection.
Easy to deal with. Good price and took the time to come out, inspect and discuss all the options.

We can wholeheartedly recommend Audra Energy. Audra was the only company that actually came to look at our site. Other companies were just a name on an email, though one installer did actually ring me. The quoting process was prompt and easy. All questions, (we had many),  were answered thoroughly with clarity and confidence and we felt very much at ease with them.Most importantly, Matt and his team turned up when they said they would. Everyone was polite, helpful and very professional. All the fears we had about the installation disappeared when they arrived and performed a flawless install. Matt also organised and submitted all the required paperwork which was a big help.The entire experience with Audra was very easy and seamless. I had some post installation queries that were all answered promptly. Our system has been functioning flawlessly, generating clean, renewable energy and significantly reducing our dependence on the grid.We highly recommend Audra Energy to anyone considering a solar installation, confident that they will receive the same great service and quality that we've experienced.

Jordan reached out to me the day after I requested quotes and came to check out the house. He then answered all my questions after comparing quotes. Installation was expected in 4 weeks and was delivered in less than 3. The team doing the install were great! Having some issues with the monitoring app not showing consumption but that appears to be an app/energy provider issue.
Matt and his efficient team did an excellent job, from the quoting process to the installation.  They were punctual and the  workmanship was impecable.   We are very pleased with the results.
Would totally recommend Audra for your solar needs they are great
Quote was fine. They arranged grid connection and install of the wifi app.
Very efficient and friendly from the quote to the installation. Great price, quality and service. Couldn't ask for anything more
Quote - easy simple quick completed onsite within week, quote within day.Install - easy - no issues, tidy up and clean.Customer service - quick and prompt and polite.

I would like to thank Finn for the service provided. The original thought of clicking to request three quotes I was apprehensive, but very glad I did. Your website has so much information that cuts through the crap. I have learnt so much about solar and various systems and I am looking forward to reaping the rewards and adding batteries down the track.Thank you again for such an informative  website.The locally family owned company who installed the 8.8kw system did a great job and were good to deal with.

We were so happy with the expertise, experience and service of Matthew, Jordan and the team. Matthew was really easy to deal with from our initial query and quotation through to completion of the job and connection to the grid. We also asked for their help with a completely separate electrical job at our home and they were very happy to assist and prioritised it for us. We can’t recommend their business more highly. Great local business!

Sales quoting process was simpleInstallation went ahead as scheduled, easy to deal withOrganised grid connection and service providersmall issue with inverter at installation which was sorted before they left siteVery happy overall

Jordan came to our home and without fuss and ‘salesman talk’ explained the system and its benefits and gave us a very competitive price. We got 2 other quotes but were impressed with Jordan’s manner and quote. The boys turned up on time and were very efficient in installing the system, which was not a straight forward job due to our electrical wiring. They were great young guys to have around doing the installation and their mother would be proud of them cleaning up after the job was completed. The system was up and running instantly as we already had some solar panels. They also shared drone shots of the system with us for our personal interest. We have recommended them to other people as we were so impressed with their service.

Matthew was excellent from quoting and providing clear written details of cost and saving potential into the future, to the finished product. Communication was exceptional and established trust and confidence.The install went as described and was seamless. Also having the app on your phone to track and monitor usage and savings is convenient and easy to understand.

Audra Energy were such an easy company to deal with. Matt came out to quote and recommended the system we chose. He kept us up to date with delivery and installation times. When they arrived to instal the system they were great. We had no problems at all, they left the space they were using clean and tidy. I have recommended these guys to quite a few people who have all gone ahead with their quote and are just as happy as us!
Quoting process was seamless, Matt was very easy to work with and the installation date even came forward! Highly recommend!!

We recently had Solar Panels installed by Audra Energy.From start to finish Jordan and Matthew were professional, friendly and so easy to deal with.They did an absolutely amazing job! I highly recommend Audra Energy.

Audra were amazing, right from the jump. We had a lot of questions around solar and batteries and Matt made time to answer them all. The house has a 3-phase setup, and Audra was the only company to recognise this and quote accordingly. Really helpful, punctual, and even re-wired the electrical box to better work with the install. The reporting to the app was a little off, so Matt came back after the install and checked everything. One small wire needed tweaking, Matt fixed this plus arranged for Sungrow to remote update the firmware as well.

Our experience with Audra Energy was absolutely faultless! Matt and the team were exceptional at every stage of our quote and install.They are very professional, prompt, tidy and their customer service and communication is second to none!I recommend Audra Energy to everyone I know!

I chose Audra over a couple of other companies and I’m really glad I did. From start to finish all communications were clear, accurate and timely. Install was perfect. On time, clean workers who tidied up after themselves. They did all the necessary paperwork, even sorted the phone app for me.  Super efficient and best value for money I could find.I am extremely satisfied with the work and delighted to recommend.

Matt was exceptional from the initial quote right through the job until the end. The quote was well explained and was for what I was after. They were very courteous during the installation process and ensured it was done without interruption. The after installation service of connecting to the grid and explaining the software and product was much appreciated and worthwhile

The boys at Audra are brilliant! They made the quote process so easy. They gave us all the information we needed and helped us every step of the way! They never bombarded us and worked to our budget and energy needs. From submitting a quote request to install was an absolute breeze. No shonky salesmen and no call centres. Local company to the Newcastle, Hunter Valley and surrounding areas. We can call them directly if we have any questions and they are always happy to help. Wouldn't recommend anyone else.

Audra Energy provided a prompt and professional service. The salesman was very informative and provided a range of options tailored to our energy usage and price range.I’ve since gone on to recommending them to family and friends who were also happy with the service.
Quoting was very easyInstall was very tidy an quickCustomer service was great, they didn’t go until they new everything was up an running fine also helped connect it to my phone
Great customer service, Fast and easy quoting process and fast turnaround for installation. Happily recommend Audra Energy to everyone.
Audra Energy had a very professional quoting service and the installation was great. Can't fault them!
